title: Circuit data v1 — the single parent of every electrical fact
description: Machine-readable circuit and experiment data is the authority for parts, pins, values, endpoints, nets and terminals; prose steps, connection tables, maps and troubleshooting are generated from it, so text and diagrams cannot drift apart. This contract carries the constraint L01-POLARITY-NEUTRAL names, and carries it unconditionally: no terminal name and no coordinate may assert a connector polarity, on any path. Naming one is a claim, and a claim needs primary evidence the structured data cannot hold — which is defect A6, the foundation lab asserting what it cannot evidence. The rule is not conditioned on rail_topology, because a polarity claimed on a path that is later powered is no better evidenced than one claimed while it is disconnected.

part_marking.description: The marking read off the physical part. Null when nobody has held one — never guessed from a photograph.

primary_sources.description: Every electrical value carries a primary source. A value recalled rather than sourced is a failed check, not a shortcut.

claim_scope.description: Exactly what this source establishes. A source cited beyond its scope is an unevidenced claim wearing a citation.

rail_topology.description: Null on an unpowered path: nothing is selected and no rail is live.

polarity_free.description: A name or coordinate that asserts no connector polarity. Anchored on the polarity vocabulary itself, not on a bare word: a terminal legitimately called `source_lead_end` or `dc_input` says nothing about which lead is which.
